fixtures.name: vc
fixtures.copy:
COPY (SELECT k::INTEGER AS id, k % 40 AS g,
  (CASE WHEN k % 19 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE k * 37 % 255 - 127 END)::TINYINT AS i8,
  (CASE WHEN k % 17 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE k * 211 % 65535 - 32767 END)::SMALLINT AS i16,
  (CASE WHEN k % 13 = 0 THEN NULL WHEN k = 1 THEN -2147483648 WHEN k = 2 THEN 2147483647 ELSE k * 100003 % 4000000000 - 2000000000 END)::INTEGER AS i32,
  (CASE WHEN k % 11 = 0 THEN NULL WHEN k = 1 THEN -9223372036854775808 WHEN k = 2 THEN 9223372036854775807 ELSE (k * 1234567891011 - 1500000000000000) * 1000 END)::BIGINT AS i64,
  (CASE WHEN k % 9 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE k % 3 = 0 END) AS b,
  (CASE WHEN k % 12 = 0 THEN NULL WHEN k = 1 THEN 'nan'::DOUBLE WHEN k = 2 THEN 'inf'::DOUBLE WHEN k = 3 THEN '-inf'::DOUBLE
        WHEN k = 4 THEN '-0.0'::DOUBLE WHEN k = 5 THEN 521345.625 WHEN k = 6 THEN 0.1 WHEN k = 7 THEN 3.4028235e38 WHEN k = 8 THEN 1e-5
        WHEN k = 10 THEN 16777216.0 WHEN k % 3 = 0 THEN ((k * 2654435 % 4000000) - 2000000) / 8.0
        WHEN k % 3 = 1 THEN sin(k) * pow(10, k % 24 - 12) ELSE (k * 7919 % 1000003) / 1000.0 END)::FLOAT AS fl,
  (CASE WHEN k % 14 = 0 THEN NULL WHEN k = 1 THEN 'nan'::DOUBLE WHEN k = 2 THEN 'inf'::DOUBLE WHEN k = 3 THEN '-inf'::DOUBLE
        WHEN k = 4 THEN '-0.0'::DOUBLE WHEN k = 5 THEN 1e15 WHEN k = 6 THEN 1e16 WHEN k = 7 THEN 5e-324 WHEN k = 8 THEN 1.7976931348623157e308
        WHEN k = 9 THEN 0.1 WHEN k = 10 THEN 123456789.123456789 WHEN k % 3 = 0 THEN ((k * 2654435 % 4000000) - 2000000) / 8.0
        WHEN k % 3 = 1 THEN sin(k) * pow(10, k % 40 - 20) ELSE (k * 7919 % 100003) / 97.0 * pow(10, k % 30 - 10) END)::DOUBLE AS db,
  (CASE WHEN k % 8 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (k % 241 - 120) * 0.5 END)::DECIMAL(4,1) AS d41,
  (CASE WHEN k % 9 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((k * 7919 % 20000001) - 10000000) * 0.01 END)::DECIMAL(9,2) AS d92,
  (CASE WHEN k % 10 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((k * 1234567891 % 2000000000000) - 1000000000000) * 0.000001 END)::DECIMAL(18,6) AS d186,
  (CASE WHEN k % 12 = 0 THEN NULL WHEN k = 5 THEN '99999999999999999999999999.9999999999'::DECIMAL(38,10)
        WHEN k = 6 THEN '-0.0000000001'::DECIMAL(38,10) ELSE ((k * 1234567891011 % 100000000000000) - 50000000000000) * 0.0000000001::DECIMAL(11,10) END)::DECIMAL(38,10) AS d3810,
  (CASE WHEN k % 7 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE k * 99991 % 20000000001 - 10000000000 END)::DECIMAL(10,0) AS d100,
  (CASE WHEN k % 17 = 0 THEN NULL WHEN k = 1 THEN '5877642-06-25 (BC)'::DATE WHEN k = 2 THEN '5881580-07-10'::DATE
        WHEN k = 3 THEN DATE '0001-01-01' WHEN k = 4 THEN '0001-01-01 (BC)'::DATE WHEN k = 6 THEN DATE '1970-01-01'
        WHEN k = 7 THEN DATE '9999-12-31' WHEN k = 8 THEN DATE '10000-01-01' WHEN k = 9 THEN '0001-12-31 (BC)'::DATE
        WHEN k % 5 = 0 THEN DATE '0001-01-01' - ((k * 911) % 800000)::INTEGER
        ELSE DATE '1900-01-01' + ((k * 37) % 80000)::INTEGER - 40000 END) AS dt,
  (CASE WHEN k % 13 = 0 THEN NULL WHEN k = 1 THEN '294247-01-10 04:00:54.775806'::TIMESTAMP WHEN k = 2 THEN '290309-12-22 (BC) 00:00:00'::TIMESTAMP
        WHEN k = 3 THEN TIMESTAMP '0001-01-01 00:00:00' WHEN k = 4 THEN TIMESTAMP '0001-01-01 00:00:00' - INTERVAL 1 MICROSECOND
        WHEN k = 5 THEN TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01 00:00:00.000001' WHEN k = 6 THEN TIMESTAMP '2000-01-01 12:34:56.789'
        WHEN k % 7 = 0 THEN make_timestamp((k * 987654321098765 % 200000000000000000) - 100000000000000000)
        ELSE TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01' + to_microseconds(((k * 7919) % 1000000007)::BIGINT * 2800000 - 1500000000000000 + k) END) AS ts,
  (CASE WHEN k % 11 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01' + to_microseconds(((k * 7919) % 1000000007)::BIGINT * 2800000 - 1500000000000000 + k * 7) END)::TIMESTAMPTZ AS tz,
  (CASE WHEN k % 15 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01' + to_microseconds(((k * 7919) % 1000000007)::BIGINT * 2800000 - 1500000000000000 + k * 13) END)::TIMESTAMP_MS AS ms,
  (CASE WHEN k % 16 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE make_timestamp_ns(((k * 7919) % 1000000007)::BIGINT * 2800000000 - 1500000000000000000 + k) END) AS ns,
  'v' || k::VARCHAR AS s
FROM range(0, 3000) t(k)) TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 700)
